system_description.narrative_summary: Across this window the single dominant narrative is an intensifying Russian campaign against Ukraine that is producing direct military escalation, broader threats to European security, and geopolitical spillovers worldwide. The pattern combines kinetic strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, alarming rhetoric (including threats to NATO-adjacent states), suspected technology and weapons transfers, and Russia's expanding influence operations — eliciting diplomatic, military and economic responses from Europe, NATO and partners. Together these dynamics create reinforcing feedbacks between battlefield escalation, allied aid and sanctions, and secondary crises in regions and markets.
system_description.scope: Inside the system: Russian military operations and strategy; Ukrainian defence and counter-strikes; NATO and EU diplomatic and military responses; allied aid, sanctions and economic ties (energy, commodities); information/ influence campaigns and suspected technology proliferation (e.g., to North Korea); immediate humanitarian and infrastructural impacts in Ukraine.
system_description.super_system: The global international security order / post‑Cold War European security architecture
adjacent_subsystems: European politics and EU decision‑making (funding, cohesion, domestic politics)
NATO and collective defence posture (forces, deployments, escalation management)
Global energy and commodities markets (fuel, potash, trade links)
Hybrid and proliferative networks (information ops, arms/tech transfers, proxy influence)

variables.name: Kinetic strike intensity
variables.description: Measures the tempo and scale of kinetic attacks (bombardment, missile, air and artillery strikes) across the theatre.

variables.name: Infrastructure damage rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which critical civil and commercial infrastructure is being damaged or degraded.

variables.name: Territorial control balance
variables.description: Measures the relative share of territory under effective control by competing military actors.

variables.name: Allied military aid flow
variables.description: Measures the rate and volume of external military materiel, training and direct support supplied to a military actor.

variables.name: Economic sanctions pressure
variables.description: Measures the intensity and economic constraining effect of financial, trade and sectoral restrictions applied to an actor.

variables.name: Energy supply disruption
variables.description: Measures the degree of interruption and volatility in energy supply chains affecting markets and consumption.

variables.name: Financial market spillover risk
variables.description: Measures the perceived risk that geopolitical shocks will transmit into broader financial market instability.

variables.name: Technology transfer risk
variables.description: Measures the likelihood and scale of transfer of military-relevant technologies and expertise between actors.

variables.name: Information and influence activity
variables.description: Measures the intensity of coordinated information operations, propaganda and influence campaigns across media and platforms.

variables.name: Adherence to rules of war
variables.description: Measures the extent to which combatant behaviour aligns with established humanitarian and legal norms governing armed conflict.

variables.name: Civilians displaced (stock)
variables.description: Measures the stock (number and concentration) of civilians displaced from homes due to conflict and insecurity.

variables.name: Humanitarian need severity
variables.description: Measures the aggregate severity of humanitarian needs including food, shelter, medical care and basic services.

variables.name: Defense readiness level
variables.description: Measures the preparedness and mobilization state of military and civil-defence forces to respond to threats.

variables.name: Diplomatic tension level
variables.description: Measures the degree of sustained diplomatic friction, official condemnation and reciprocal measures between states.

variables.name: Hybrid attack activity
variables.description: Measures the rate and scale of non-kinetic hostile actions (cyberattacks, sabotage, covert operations, economic coercion) conducted in combination with other modes of conflict.

variables.name: Commodity supply gap
variables.description: Measures the shortfall between supply and demand for critical commodities (energy, agricultural inputs, strategic materials) induced by the crisis.

catalysts.title: Imminent surge in Russian strikes on Ukraine
catalysts.description: Intelligence and Kremlin statements indicate Moscow is preparing a massive attack and pledging intensified strikes on Kyiv and infrastructure, likely increasing strike tempo.
catalysts.rationale: Zelenskiy: intelligence shows Russia preparing massive attack; Russia pledges to continue massive strikes on Kyiv; Russia ramps up attacks on Kyiv infrastructure.

catalysts.title: EU envoys approve major new Russia sanctions
catalysts.description: EU envoys are set to approve a package of major new sanctions against Russia, tightening economic and financial restrictions.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'EU envoys set to approve major new Russia sanctions on Wednesday.'

catalysts.title: Sweden deploys Patriot missiles to Poland
catalysts.description: Sweden will deploy Patriot air-defence batteries to a NATO hub in Poland, enhancing regional air defences and readiness.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Sweden to deploy Patriot missiles to NATO hub in Poland.'

catalysts.title: Estonia shifts troops closer to Russia
catalysts.description: Estonia is repositioning forces closer to its border under an 'active defence' push, raising regional readiness and signalling deterrence.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Estonia shifts troops closer to Russia in ‘active defence’ push'; 'Estonia moves troops closer to Russian border.'

catalysts.title: Rising North Korea–Russia military cooperation and tests
catalysts.description: Recent DPRK missile and hypersonic drills and public support for Russia raise the risk of weapons and technology transfers between Pyongyang and Moscow.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'North Korea conducted intermediate-range strategic missile drill'; 'Ukraine believes Russia shared jet-drone technology with North Korea.'

catalysts.title: Ukraine deploys robots, tactical missiles and drones
catalysts.description: Ukraine has begun using robot offensives, FP‑7 tactical ballistic missiles and deeper drone strikes, likely altering strike patterns and damage profiles.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Ukraine’s surprise robot offensive'; 'Ukraine deploys FP-7 tactical ballistic missile'; 'Ukrainian drones kill two, hit fuel hub.'

catalysts.title: Hungary set to drop veto on Ukraine/Moldova EU progress
catalysts.description: Reports that Hungary is poised to drop its veto would permit EU progress on Ukraine/Moldova accession files, shifting political and support dynamics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Hungary set to drop veto on Ukraine and Moldova EU bid progress.'

catalysts.title: International pressure over suspected Siberian plague lab death
catalysts.description: US and other actors escalate pressure and seek information about a suspected plague-lab worker death in Siberia, prompting diplomatic friction and investigations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'U.S. Escalates Pressure on Russia Over Siberia Lab Death'; 'Russia plague: What we know...'

catalysts.title: Potential US military base in Lithuania considered
catalysts.description: Lithuania's offer to pay costs if the US establishes a base signals possible expansion of US presence in the Baltics, likely to affect regional posture and responses.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Lithuania says it would pay the cost if US establishes military base'; 'Kremlin warns Lithuania...'
